chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Dave Peyton's band at the Cafe de Paris
summary: After Doc Cook, Zutty played with Dave Peyton at the Cafe de Paris, a big nightclub where Ethel Waters opened a show and Sophie Tucker and Vincent Lopez came.

bands.name: Doc Cook and His Seventeen Interns

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Oh yes, that's right. Yes. And then he says, worked with Doc Cook and Dave Peyton at Café de Paris.
Yes, Dave Peyton-that was a fine band also.
That was after Doc Cook wasn't it?
Yes. That was after Doc Cook.
Was the Café de Paris a nightclub?

Yes. That was a big nightclub. Ethel Walters opened there because she was in town for, she had a show, 'Americana' or something like that. And she used to come in there and play met Ben Pollack and Vincent Lopez and Sophie Tucker in there one night.
And Ethel had a good show you know. Welles and Mordecai oh, they had several good acts you know. A good chorus and everything.
When you are at the Café de Paris though I take it that you were not working at the Nest then?
You couldn't do that could you, no?
